title: A law of large numbers for kinetic interacting diffusions
comment: 25 pages, remark added in the introduction
abstract: We study the convergence of the empirical distribution associated with a system of interacting kinetic particles subject to independent Brownian forcing in a finite horizon setting, using some recent progress on kinetic non-linear partial differential equations. Under general assumptions that require only weak convergence on the initial datum -- without assuming independence or moment conditions -- we prove convergence in probability to the corresponding non-linear Fokker-Planck PDE.
